title: When and Why LLM Causal Priors Help: Closed-Loop Prior Selection for Amortized Causal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.06941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal effect estimation asks how an outcome would change under an intervention, and medicine, economics, and public policy all treat it as a foundational task. Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) amortize the task: a model trained on large numbers of programmatically generated synthetic causal tasks reads a new problem's observational data into context and returns an interventional-effect estimate in a single forward pass. The capability of such models is largely determined by the synthetic training prior, which is currently designed by hand, a bottleneck acknowledged by both Do-PFN and CausalPFN. Large language models (LLMs) can now ``draw'' plausible causal graphs for a given domain, suggesting that LLM-distilled graphs could serve as prior material. translated_title: 何时以及为何大语言模型因果先验有帮助：面向摊销因果推断的闭环先验选择
translated_abstract: 因果效应估计研究在干预之下结果会如何变化，医学、经济学和公共政策均将其视为一项基础任务。先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）将该任务摊销化：一个在大量程序化生成的合成因果任务上训练的模型，将新问题的观测数据读入上下文，并在单次前向传播中返回干预效应估计。此类模型的能力在很大程度上由合成训练先验决定，而该先验目前依赖手工设计——这是 Do-PFN 和 CausalPFN 都承认的瓶颈。大语言模型（LLMs）如今能够为给定领域“绘制”合理的因果图，这暗示 LLM 提炼出的图可充当先验材料。然而，注入此类图是否真有帮助、收益从何而来、以及在什么情况下注入才有用，目前的实践仍依赖人工试错。我们提出了一种闭环先验选择方法……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种闭环先验选择方法，用于系统性地判定何时以及为何将大语言模型生成的因果图注入合成训练先验，从而提升摊销式因果效应估计的效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes a closed-loop prior selection method to systematically determine when and why injecting LLM-generated causal graphs into synthetic training priors improves amortized causal effect estimation.
